requirement: A register of in-scope privileged accounts confirming default and static shared credentials have been changed, vaulted or removed.
example_artifact: e.g., a vault onboarded-accounts export listing account, credential type and status

requirement: Evidence that privileged service-account credentials are managed and rotated (e.g. group Managed Service Accounts or broker-managed leases) rather than static shared passwords.
example_artifact: e.g., a gMSA configuration or a service-account rotation report

requirement: The credential vaulting and rotation policy showing privileged credentials are rotated on schedule and on check-in/release, commensurate with the criticality of the protected assets.
example_artifact: e.g., the vault rotation policy document or platform configuration export

requirement: Evidence that automated credential-rotation failures raise an alert to an on-call owner.
example_artifact: e.g., a rotation-failure alert rule and a sample alert or ticket

requirement: Evidence that no plaintext privileged credentials persist in scripts, configuration or source.
example_artifact: e.g., a secret-scan report over scripts and configuration showing no privileged plaintext secrets

requirement: Evidence that privileged accounts are separated from standard accounts and prevented from accessing the internet, email and web services.
example_artifact: e.g., the privileged-account policy and an internet/email/web block ruleset with the covered-account list

requirement: Evidence that privileged access is granted just-in-time and time-bound rather than held as standing privilege.
example_artifact: e.g., a just-in-time elevation policy and a sample of time-bound grants with expiry

requirement: Evidence that privileged sessions and access events are captured to a centralised logging facility with searchable metadata.
example_artifact: e.g., the centralised session-recording or log store and a searchable-index sample

requirement: Evidence that privileged access logs and session recordings are protected from unauthorised modification or deletion and retained per policy.
example_artifact: e.g., an immutable-storage/WORM configuration and the retention policy for session recordings

requirement: Evidence that high-risk privileged commands are flagged for review within recorded sessions.
example_artifact: e.g., the command-flagging ruleset and a sample flagged-session review

requirement: A SAW/PAW fleet inventory mapping each tier-0 / privileged administrator to a dedicated hardened admin workstation, with hardening-baseline compliance status (application control, no standing local admin, patch state) and exceptions registered with owner and expiry.
example_artifact: e.g., a SAW device inventory with per-device baseline-compliance status and the tier-0 operator mapping

requirement: Evidence that access to tier-0 targets from non-SAW devices is technically blocked (proxy or conditional-access device filter) and that privileged accounts used from SAWs are prevented from reaching internet, email and web services, with a sample blocked-attempt alert.
example_artifact: e.g., the conditional-access / proxy device-filter rule plus a sample blocked-attempt alert
